content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **JVM Classes and Runtime Compatibility** as part of **Kotlin and Java Interoperability**. Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. Use the subtopics—Bytecode and Class Files, JVM Target Versions, Binary Compatibility and Public API Evolution—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Real projects depend on reliable error handling, modular organization, reproducible builds, and safe language boundaries. This lesson helps turn isolated syntax into maintainable applications.
